name: Companion App
description: Unified responsive control surface for the Android Companion and any phone browser — full remote and guide navigation, Time Machine, channel management, live alerts/ticker, every box-wide and plugin setting, and channel-folder browsing/downloads. One authenticated UI and pairing covers all features, so Android and browser controls stay in sync.

ipc.why: receives the current channel/name from the renderer, to answer the phone remote's GET /state

net.why: the Android companion app and the phone-browser remote connect to this from the LAN
